# Fetch-plan vectors

Source: prefrontal repository, commit `65195cc3fbc437eb55950874b593a3d1eb319e60`,
path `test-vectors/fetch-plan-v1/`. Payload files are copied without modification;
the local README describes fixture formats and reproduction.

Every digested vector has three files with one stem:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `<name>.json` | pretty JSON, keys in a readable order |
| `<name>.jcs` | exact RFC 8785 bytes: UTF-8, no trailing newline |
| `<name>.sha256` | SHA-256 of `.jcs`: 64 lowercase hex characters, no trailing newline |

`.gitattributes` marks `.jcs` and `.sha256` as binary so checkout does not rewrite them.
`compositions/` and `plans/` contain digested objects; `sends/` contains first-send
bodies; `calls/` contains relayed-call examples; `admission/` contains expected
admission outcomes. `subscriptions.json` and `catalog-requests.json` cover hook
vocabulary and catalog request shapes. `generate.py` produces the files and digests.

`commons/tool-provider-v1-composition-digest.json` comes from the commons repository,
commit `25e29afe80dea2ec159473f545246707b82746b5`, path
`test-vectors/tool-provider-v1/composition-digest.json`, SHA-256
`714af3c3a1504231e86cd5a4fe9c066214ef65d2d43a3aa8894df6555977ac1e`.

To update, run `python3 test-vectors/fetch-plan-v1/generate.py` in the source
repository (`--check` verifies without writing), copy the payload directory, and
update the source commit and `PINNED_IDENTITIES` in broca's `tests/vectors.rs`.
Do not hand-edit digests or embedded plan copies. Keep this README focused on
provenance and fixture reproduction.
